fatal_blockers: The fixed unweighted complete pair-bag template has an asymptotic clause-drop attack. For a minimally unsatisfiable m-clause formula, choose a clause i whose canonical-star indegree d_i is at most 1, satisfy F\{C_i}, and zero all bags incident to i; its squared distance is B+25[2m-2+d_i(m-3)]=B+O(m), while B=Theta(m^2), so the distance ratio tends to 1.

The proposed B+64 audit cannot escape that blocker: it is another shell test on the same hardcoded nine-clause instance. No composition, hierarchy, weighting law, or zero-residual lower bound proportional to B is supplied, so polynomial-factor GapCVP hardness remains unsupported.

The verifier is not an exhaustive unrestricted-vector search. Its zero-residual certificate enumerates exceptional bag sets and then invokes a structural argument, while the one-residual routine merely returns hand-coded case labels; exit code 0 therefore does not independently certify those logical cases beyond the inspectable proof.
